name: FLYHIGH_PRD_GOLD.WAREHOUSE.SV_SITE_OPS
tables:
task | FLYHIGH_PRD_GOLD.WAREHOUSE.FACT_WAREHOUSE_TASK | TASK_ID
site | FLYHIGH_PRD_GOLD.WAREHOUSE.DIM_SITE | SITE_KEY
dt | FLYHIGH_PRD_GOLD.WAREHOUSE.DIM_DATE | DATE_KEY
facts:
task.units = UNITS_HANDLED
task.direct_hours = DURATION_MIN / 60
task.error_qty = SHORT_ERROR_QTY
task.pick_lines = LINES_HANDLED
dimensions:
site.site_name = SITE_NAME
site.region = REGION
dt.fiscal_week = FISCAL_WEEK
dt.calendar_date = CALENDAR_DATE
metrics:
task.uph = SUM(task.units) / NULLIF(SUM(task.direct_hours), 0)
task.pick_accuracy = 1 - SUM(task.error_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(task.pick_lines), 0)
